exposure: Assisted reproductive technology (ART) in women with dyspareunia
cohort: The study participants were 23 female patients experiencing dyspareunia and undergoing assisted reproductive technology treatment at the Reproductive Medicine Center of Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine.
finding: The study identified five prominent themes related to the experience of ART in women with dyspareunia: psychological disturbances, incongruent cognitive perceptions, anticipations regarding conception, insufficient adaptive responses, and sexual expectations.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between July 2022 and December 2022.
